# Sector-rank growth under finite blockade

Swept the symmetric blockaded C_kZ family from deep toward moderate blockade on
the emulator twin. Hessian rank grows with atom count faster than the perfect-
blockade 3n line at every non-deep setting, with no super-polynomial blowup up
to the largest n attempted.
